comment: The columns of Saved/procgen_corpus.tsv, in order, and the words it uses for star classes and planet kinds. DeepSpace.Universe.Corpus holds the file it writes to this; Tools/procgen_corpus.py reads by these names and Tools/test_procgen_corpus.py holds its hand-made sample to them. One row per planet; a system with no planets is one row with planet -1 and the planet columns empty, so an empty system is counted rather than lost.
